_about: Every schedule in the system as data, generated from services/reply_engine/modal_app.py by changesets/schedules/build_schedules.py. Do not edit by hand: regenerate.
_mode: Every entry is mode=shadow. MODE=live plus ALLOW_LIVE_WRITES=1 is the only combination that writes anything. On Modal that pair lives in the secret; on the laptop the runner sets it per job, live only for a tier named in LAPTOP_LIVE_TIERS. Flipping either is a Lorenzo-approved step (runbooks/deployment.md).
_split: runtime=modal schedules are registered by `modal deploy` when their tier is in DEPLOY_TIERS (default: sales only). runtime=laptop schedules hand off through files and never run on Modal; changesets/schedules/laptop/ holds their STAGED launchd plists and crontab lines, which run changesets/schedules/laptop_runner.py.
_timezone: cron_ct is what is scheduled: modal.Cron reads it in America/Chicago, so the CT times are literal. cron_utc_cdt and cron_utc_cst exist only for a scheduler that cannot take a timezone; CDT ends 2026-11-01 and CST ends 2027-03-14, and a job left on a fixed UTC cron moves by an hour on each of those dates.
_install: Nothing here is installed. install_schedules.sh --deploy (Lorenzo's terminal) deploys the Modal half; the laptop half is copied into place by hand (runbooks/deployment.md).
_turned_off: Jobs Lorenzo turned off (he runs them by hand). Not scheduled anywhere; listed so a reader can say 'turned off' rather than 'missing'. Source: config/turned_off_jobs.json.

schedules.name: appointments_tick
schedules.purpose: Show-rate confirmations and no-show detection for booked calls (S4/S5).
schedules.writes: GHL appointment status, SMS and email legs (guarded)

schedules.name: approval_escalation
schedules.purpose: The 5-minute reply SLA chase (S1): a rising ntfy push for every approval card Lorenzo has not actioned, counted in sending minutes. The poller runs the same chase; this tick exists so an Instantly failure in the poller cannot silence it.
schedules.when_ct: every 5 minutes, beside poller; it chases only, it cannot send
schedules.writes: nothing but ntfy pushes; it takes no Instantly client and no rung of it can send
needs: BASE_URL, or every Approve/Veto button on the chase card points at localhost
NTFY_TOPIC (and NTFY_TOKEN if the card should carry names)

schedules.name: autoresponder_canary
schedules.purpose: Measure auto-responder rate per inbox (M1 level 4 / O7).
needs: a decision on canary-mailing real prospects (DECISIONS Q-J10)

a usable address pool: 17 today. Each address is mailed once a round, so 12 inboxes need 60 for the 5-per-inbox verdict minimum (CANARY_MIN_ADDRESSES_FOR_VERDICT) and 120 for the full 10 per inbox (CANARY_ADDRESSES_PER_INBOX)
schedules.why_laptop: writes the level-4 sidecar and the dated change-set the 07:00 monitor reads

schedules.name: cadence_tick
schedules.purpose: Send the due follow-up touch for every armed lead (S2), 07:00-19:00 CT.
schedules.when_ct: hourly 07:00-19:00 CT; the function re-checks the CT send window itself
schedules.cron_utc_cdt: 0 7-19 * * *  # CROSSES MIDNIGHT UTC: split this range by hand
schedules.cron_utc_cst: 0 7-19 * * *  # CROSSES MIDNIGHT UTC: split this range by hand

schedules.name: cadence_veto_ping
schedules.purpose: The 09:30 CT half-hour run the D1 veto window needs. The D1 touch auto-sends after a 30-minute veto window opened by a push; an hourly tick never serves it.
schedules.when_ct: 09:30 CT weekdays: the half-hour run the D1 veto window needs
schedules.writes: the D1 veto push, then the send after the window closes (guarded)

schedules.name: client_scorecard
schedules.purpose: Weekly client cards and the F4 retention touches (F3/F4).
schedules.when_ct: Fri 19:15 CT, after the sending day closes (F3/F4)
schedules.cron_utc_cdt: 15 0 * * 5  # NOTE: this is the NEXT UTC day; shift the day-of-week too
schedules.cron_utc_cst: 15 1 * * 5  # NOTE: this is the NEXT UTC day; shift the day-of-week too
schedules.writes: cards and drafts under .tmp/scorecards/, one ntfy digest and a Job_Log row; never sends to a client (delivery is manual, by Lorenzo)
needs: campaign ids on each roster row; Mike has none, so his card reads 'no source'
schedules.why_laptop: needs the client roster and templates on disk

schedules.name: daily_metrics
schedules.purpose: The daily scorecard row, the DAILY UPDATE block and the Section 6 KPI dashboard (O4).
schedules.cron_utc_cst: 0 0 * * *  # NOTE: this is the NEXT UTC day; shift the day-of-week too
schedules.writes: a Google Sheets row (guarded) and a STAGED Skool post that is never auto-published
needs: a fresh Skool auth token before the first real post
schedules.why_laptop: reads the list-factory ledger and the Job_Log from disk for the KPI dashboard

schedules.name: deliverability_monitor

schedules.writes: proposals into changesets/inbox_actions/<date>.json, one ntfy card
schedules.why_laptop: reads the placement and canary sidecars and writes proposals into changesets/inbox_actions/, which Lorenzo reviews on disk

schedules.name: inbox_inventory

schedules.writes: config/inbox_inventory.json, one ntfy digest and a Job_Log row; nothing live

schedules.name: inbox_placement

schedules.writes: changesets/inbox_actions/<date>.json + last_placement.json; NEVER fires the create
needs: seed addresses (no read-only endpoint lists them; copy them from one UI test)
schedules.why_laptop: writes the level-2 sidecar and the dated change-set the 07:00 monitor reads

schedules.name: list_factory
schedules.purpose: Source, score, verify, personalise and stage next week's list (O8).
schedules.when_ct: Sun 09:00 CT (O8); PAID whenever ALLOW_PAID_CALLS=1, live or not
schedules.writes: a staged CSV and create_lead would_do records
needs: ALLOW_PAID_CALLS=1 (the runner sets it only when LAPTOP_PAID_JOBS names this job)
the client-domain suppression list, which is empty today
schedules.why_laptop: stages a CSV, keeps its resumable run state and cost ledger on disk, and needs the real source and suppression files
schedules.shadow_note: This is the ONE scheduled job that spends through ALLOW_PAID_CALLS. Shadow stops the Instantly writes, but Apify, Perplexity, MillionVerifier and this job's own model calls are gated by ALLOW_PAID_CALLS=1 ALONE (owner decision R7): a shadow run with the flag set spends. The laptop runner passes ALLOW_PAID_CALLS=0 unless LAPTOP_PAID_JOBS names list_factory; keep it that way until Lorenzo approves a figure (DECISIONS R14: the preflight prices about $10.20 a niche, and the cost-per-contact cap halts every real run before Apify until then). The flag does not stop Anthropic spend anywhere else.

schedules.name: no_show_watch
schedules.purpose: The "I'm on" nudge 5 minutes after a booked call starts (S5 N1); does nothing when no call is on.
schedules.when_ct: every minute 12:00-18:59 CT weekdays; one container at a time (max_containers=1)
schedules.cron_utc_cst: * 12-18 * * 1-5  # CROSSES MIDNIGHT UTC: split this range by hand
schedules.writes: the N1 I'm-on email in the lead's thread and the no-show flag (guarded; a one-time claim per call stops a second email when it overlaps the 10-minute tick)
